title: Client Subsidy of Vend Prices Under the Vending Services Program
content:
Whether the client subsidises vend prices and is invoiced for it, the share of the vend price that subsidy meets, and the ceiling on the subsidy drawn for one employee on one day are all fixed by the programme the Vending Services Program agreement is written at.

| Programme | Client subsidises vend prices and is invoiced for it | Share of the vend price met by client subsidy | Ceiling on subsidy for one employee on one day |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | no | 0.00 percent | 0.00 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | no | 0.00 percent | 0.00 |
| Combination Vending Bank | yes | 15.00 percent | 3.00 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | yes | 25.00 percent | 5.00 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | yes | 20.00 percent | 4.50 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | yes | 30.00 percent | 7.00 |

The share is a percentage of the vend price. The ceiling is an amount in US dollars and is stated for one employee on one day.

### The two unsubsidised programmes

The Single Machine Snack Service and the Snack & Cold Beverage Bank are the two programmes written without client subsidy, and both carry 0.00 percent as the share and 0.00 as the daily ceiling. On the four subsidised programmes the share runs from 15.00 percent on the Combination Vending Bank to 30.00 percent on the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service, and the daily ceiling from 3.00 to 7.00.

### Worked illustration of the two figures together (hypothetical purchases)

On an estate held at the Fresh Food Vending Service, where the share is 25.00 percent and the daily ceiling is 5.00, an employee buying items at a vend price of 8.00 in one day draws subsidy of 2.00, being 25.00 percent of that vend price, which is within the ceiling of 5.00 for that employee on that day. The same employee buying items at a vend price of 24.00 in one day would draw 6.00 at the printed share, which stands above the ceiling, so the subsidy drawn for that employee on that day is held to 5.00. The vend prices chosen here are illustrative and are not programme figures.

The two figures printed against a subsidised programme do not rise together across the schedule: the Campus Vending Network Service carries a share of 20.00 percent with a ceiling of 4.50, while the Combination Vending Bank carries 15.00 percent with a ceiling of 3.00.
